_readme: Every line the office slice shows. The key is the line's id: a voice recording saved as res://audio/vo/<id>.ogg plays automatically with that line. Speakers: narrator, adrian, tom. Narrator lines are captions; adrian and tom speak in boxes over their heads. BBCode works: [shake], [wave], [color=#hex].

intro_2.speaker: narrator
intro_2.text: Rain on the glass. Rent on the desk. A radiator that had stopped pretending.

intro_3.speaker: narrator
intro_3.text: Four floors up, behind frosted glass that spelled his name backward, [color=#d01e2a]Adrian Vale[/color] waited for the day to find him.

intro_4.speaker: narrator
intro_4.text: He had time for [color=#d01e2a]three small things[/color].

photo_1.speaker: narrator
photo_1.text: Sylvia. Seventeen. Caught mid-laugh, like the camera had told her a bad joke.

photo_2.speaker: narrator
photo_2.text: He talked about her to anyone who'd sit still. The frame was the only thing in the office he'd paid full price for.

envelope_1.speaker: narrator
envelope_1.text: An envelope for Worcester, in his own careful hand. The month's money for home.

envelope_2.speaker: narrator
envelope_2.text: Always sent. [color=#8a8a8a]Never quite enough to stop sending.[/color]

pistol_1.speaker: narrator
pistol_1.text: Bottom drawer. Under files that paid in promises: a pistol he owned and didn't love.

pistol_2.speaker: narrator
pistol_2.text: Bought because a man in his line was supposed to. Never once carried. [shake rate=14 level=8][color=#d01e2a]Dead witnesses can't talk.[/color][/shake]

pistol_take.speaker: narrator
pistol_take.text: He weighed it. Tucked it into his waistband, under the vest. It sat there like a held breath.

pistol_leave.speaker: narrator
pistol_leave.text: He closed the drawer. Not for the first time.

gin_1.speaker: narrator
gin_1.text: Third drawer of the cabinet. Good gin, two-thirds full.

gin_2.speaker: narrator
gin_2.text: For after work. Never during. [color=#8a8a8a]It wasn't after yet.[/color]

knife_1.speaker: narrator
knife_1.text: In the coat on the rack: a folding knife. Long, slim, black-handled. No monogram.

knife_2.speaker: narrator
knife_2.text: For opening boxes. He pocketed it, same as every morning.

bills_1.speaker: narrator
bills_1.text: Bills, sorted with care into the order he meant to ignore them. Rent. Telephone. A tailor whose handwriting had turned unfriendly.

bills_2.speaker: narrator
bills_2.text: The office was afloat. The way a man treading water is afloat.

already.speaker: narrator
already.text: He'd looked. Looking again wouldn't change it.

no_time.speaker: narrator
no_time.text: No more time for small things.

knock_2.speaker: narrator
knock_2.text: Not a client's knock. Clients knock like they're apologizing. This was a man who'd knocked on doors that didn't want to open.

tom_enter.speaker: narrator
tom_enter.text: Broad enough to fill the doorway. A nose broken once and set in a hurry. A scar along the jaw. He took in the office in one look, and didn't think much of it.

tom_pistol.speaker: narrator
tom_pistol.text: His eyes found the shape under Vale's vest. Rested there. Moved on.

tom_1.speaker: tom
tom_1.text: Vale? Garrity. I work for Mr. Edmund Wycliffe.

narr_drink.speaker: narrator
narr_drink.text: Neither was Vale. First thing they agreed on.

tom_2.speaker: tom
tom_2.text: Something walked out of his house in Brookline. A hair ornament. White diamonds, made like a rose with frost on it.

tom_3.speaker: tom
tom_3.text: He wants it back. Quiet. No cops. No papers.

narr_why.speaker: narrator
narr_why.text: Said like a line he'd been handed. He looked at Vale like a job he hadn't decided how to do.

tom_4.speaker: tom
tom_4.text: The girl who wears it. Prima at the Civic Ballet, come spring. And a Miss Ashcroft at his museum. Knows its history better than he does.

say_haggle.speaker: adrian
say_haggle.text: For a diamond you can't report stolen? [color=#d01e2a]Thirty.[/color]

bills_fee.speaker: narrator
bills_fee.text: He thought of the tailor's letter. Found his voice.

tom_fee_lose.speaker: tom
tom_fee_lose.text: Twenty. He said you'd haggle, too.

narr_fee_lose.speaker: narrator
narr_fee_lose.text: Garrity's face didn't move. It didn't need to.

narr_close.speaker: narrator
narr_close.text: The door shut. The office got smaller.

end_1.speaker: narrator
end_1.text: A stolen rose. A dancer. A museum full of other men's treasures.

end_2.speaker: narrator
end_2.text: For the first time in a long while: [color=#d01e2a]a case.[/color]
